lines.zh: 我一步跨过两格土路。
lines.en: One step carries me over two blocks of dirt path.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下轻轻震。
lines.en: The ground trembles slightly under my feet.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只脚，可还是很快。
lines.en: I drag one foot, yet I am still fast.

lines.zh: 手臂太长，走路时蹭着草。
lines.en: My arms are so long they brush the grass.

lines.zh: 村庄的墙，我一步就跨过去。
lines.en: A village wall takes me a single stride.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整条路盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole path.

lines.zh: 我闻着热乎的味道往前。
lines.en: I walk toward the smell of something warm.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出一个小坑。
lines.en: Every step leaves a small crater.

lines.zh: 我低头走，怕撞到树干。
lines.en: I walk with my head low, fearing tree trunks.

lines.zh: 脚上的泥越粘越厚。
lines.en: Mud clings thicker and thicker to my feet.

lines.zh: 我不绕路，直接撞开。
lines.en: I do not go around; I smash straight through.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，我的膝盖会响。
lines.en: Walk slower; my knees make noise.

lines.zh: 我记得这片田，以前我在这干活。
lines.en: I know this field; I once worked it.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着，我的皮还是凉的。
lines.en: The sun shines, and my hide stays cold.

lines.zh: 我从田埂上过去，庄稼全倒。
lines.en: I cross the field ridge and the crops fall.

lines.zh: 我抬腿跨过栅栏，木头断了。
lines.en: I lift a leg over the fence and the wood snaps.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，喉咙里挤出低吼。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, low growls squeezing out.

lines.zh: 站直了，我的头快碰到树冠。
lines.en: Standing straight, my head nearly reaches the canopy.

lines.zh: 我在挠脖子，指甲太钝。
lines.en: I scratch my neck, but my nails are too blunt.

lines.zh: 有一股腐味，跟着我走。
lines.en: A rotting smell follows me around.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很重，像风箱。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy, like a bellows.

lines.zh: 破布挂在肩上，早就不成衣。
lines.en: Ragged cloth hangs off my shoulder, no longer clothes.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的手，觉得陌生。
lines.en: I stare at my own hand like it is a stranger's.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己被埋了多久。
lines.en: I cannot recall how long I was buried.

lines.zh: 肩膀痒，那里曾插着一把剑。
lines.en: My shoulder itches where a sword once stuck.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，关节咔咔响。
lines.en: I try to make a fist, and my joints crack.

lines.zh: 我闻不到自己身上的味了。
lines.en: I can no longer smell myself.

lines.zh: 有苍蝇绕着我转，我不赶它。
lines.en: Flies circle me, and I do not swat them.

lines.zh: 你比上次那个矮一点。
lines.en: You are a bit shorter than the last one.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲很亮，我喜欢砸亮的。
lines.en: Your armor is shiny; I like smashing shiny things.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，是在等我吗？
lines.en: You stand still; are you waiting for me?

lines.zh: 为了看你，我把头低到胸口。
lines.en: To see you, I lower my head to my chest.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，太细了。
lines.en: That sword in your hand is too thin.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我三步外都听见。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat from three paces away.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里没有害怕，很好。
lines.en: There is no fear in your eyes; good.

lines.zh: 你挡在门口，我就得弯腰。
lines.en: Standing in the doorway, you make me stoop.

lines.zh: 我们是不是见过？我记不清。
lines.en: Have we met? I cannot quite recall.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，像那把锤子。
lines.en: You smell of iron, like that hammer.

lines.zh: 这一剑，砍进我肩膀半寸。
lines.en: That sword bit half an inch into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我不太疼，只是被惹火了。
lines.en: It barely hurts; it just angers me.

lines.zh: 你打我的膝盖，我差点跪下。
lines.en: You hit my knee and I nearly knelt.

lines.zh: 皮开了，里面还是旧的。
lines.en: The skin split, and inside is still old.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，林子里的鸟都飞了。
lines.en: I roar, and every bird in the woods takes off.

lines.zh: 这一下让我脚跟陷进土里。
lines.en: That blow drove my heels into the dirt.

lines.zh: 箭头断在我背上，我没管。
lines.en: The arrowhead snapped off in my back; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂下来，又抬起来。
lines.en: My arm drops, then rises again.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，打在同一处。
lines.en: You strike true, right on the same spot.

lines.zh: 伤口里流出的东西很慢。
lines.en: What leaks from the wound is very slow.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，晃得我头晕。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh makes my head swim.

lines.zh: 你拿着肉？再举高一点。
lines.en: You hold meat? Raise it a little higher.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，生的也行。
lines.en: I am not picky; raw will do.

lines.zh: 那边有村民的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear villagers over there.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉还在滴水。
lines.en: The meat in your hand is still dripping.

lines.zh: 香味钻进鼻子，我走不了直路。
lines.en: The smell reaches my nose and I cannot walk straight.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，久到忘了饱。
lines.en: I have been hungry so long I forgot fullness.

lines.zh: 你把肉扔远，我就会去捡。
lines.en: Throw the meat away, and I will go fetch it.

lines.zh: 我不吃南瓜，那东西太硬。
lines.en: I do not eat pumpkin; it is too hard.

lines.zh: 鸡汤的味道？我从前喝过。
lines.en: Chicken soup? I drank that once, long ago.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞一棵老树。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting an old tree.

lines.zh: 我侧身，你就被挤开了。
lines.en: I turn sideways, and you get shoved aside.

lines.zh: 站我脚边？我一低头就漏掉你。
lines.en: Standing at my feet? One glance down and I lose you.

lines.zh: 我的肚子硬得像块石头。
lines.en: My belly is hard as stone.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你的肩膀会麻。
lines.en: One bump, and your shoulder goes numb.

lines.zh: 我退不了，后面是墙。
lines.en: I cannot step back; there is a wall behind me.

lines.zh: 我的手臂扫过，你转了半圈。
lines.en: My arm sweeps past, and you spin half around.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚背，我没什么感觉。
lines.en: You step on my foot, and I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 我们卡在门口了，你先退。
lines.en: We are stuck in the doorway; you back out first.

lines.zh: 我一转身，就把你撞进草里。
lines.en: I turn and knock you into the grass.

lines.zh: 两个大家伙站一起，路就断了。
lines.en: Two big ones together block the whole road.

lines.zh: 我拍胸口，它也拍胸口。
lines.en: I pound my chest, and it pounds back.

lines.zh: 它比我高半个头，我不服。
lines.en: It stands half a head taller; I do not accept that.

lines.zh: 我们的吼声撞在一起。
lines.en: Our roars collide in the air.

lines.zh: 它把腐肉推给我，我推回去。
lines.en: It pushes rotten flesh to me; I push it back.

lines.zh: 并肩站着，地都在抖。
lines.en: Standing side by side, even the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 我替它挠背，它替我挡风。
lines.en: I scratch its back; it blocks the wind for me.

lines.zh: 两个影子叠成一个。
lines.en: Our two shadows merge into one.

lines.zh: 它走了，我跟着，慢半步。
lines.en: It walks off, and I follow half a step behind.

lines.zh: 我们都记得同一片坟地。
lines.en: We both remember the same graveyard.

lines.zh: 我捏碎一块圆石，像捏泥。
lines.en: I crush a cobblestone the way you crush clay.

lines.zh: 这把锤子太轻，我拎着玩。
lines.en: This hammer is too light; I carry it for fun.

lines.zh: 地上有把铁剑，我踩断了。
lines.en: There is an iron sword; I step and snap it.

lines.zh: 我把门板拆下来当盾。
lines.en: I tear off a door to use as a shield.

lines.zh: 我捡东西要弯腰，很麻烦。
lines.en: Picking things up means stooping, which is a nuisance.

lines.zh: 这块肉掉在泥里，我照样吃。
lines.en: This meat fell in mud; I eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我抓住一只鸡，它啄我手指。
lines.en: I grab a chicken, and it pecks my finger.

lines.zh: 铁锭在我手里像块糖。
lines.en: An iron ingot feels like candy in my hand.

lines.zh: 我抱起一整只箱子，晃了晃。
lines.en: I lift a whole chest and give it a shake.

lines.zh: 谁掉的头盔？我戴不上。
lines.en: Whose helmet is this? It will not fit me.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道要打。
lines.en: The moment you raise a hand, I know it is a fight.

lines.zh: 你步子乱了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your steps faltered; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我先把脚站稳，再冲。
lines.en: I plant my feet first, then charge.

lines.zh: 那个拿盾的，先解决你。
lines.en: You with the shield, you go first.

lines.zh: 远处的弓手，我等会儿再管。
lines.en: The archer far off can wait.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着铁，我闻到了。
lines.en: Iron hangs at your waist; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，是给你提个醒。
lines.en: My low growl is a warning to you.

lines.zh: 你跑不远的，我腿长。
lines.en: You will not get far; my legs are long.

lines.zh: 我握紧拳头，关节都白了。
lines.en: I clench my fist until the knuckles whiten.

lines.zh: 你站得那么直，很好瞄准。
lines.en: You stand so straight, easy to aim at.

lines.zh: 有人在我背后放箭，我转身。
lines.en: Someone shoots my back; I turn around.

lines.zh: 我认准你了，别换位置。
lines.en: I have picked you; do not switch places.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的影子就压过去。
lines.en: Go left, and my shadow bears down there.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，脚不会骗人。
lines.en: I watch your feet; feet do not lie.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋里，我就拆屋。
lines.en: Hide in a house, and I will take it apart.

lines.zh: 我抬手了，你还有一步时间。
lines.en: My arm is up; you have one step of time.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，我干脆站着等。
lines.en: You circle; I simply stand and wait.

lines.zh: 你的盾举得太高，下面空着。
lines.en: Your shield is too high; below is open.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，其实我也眨不了。
lines.en: I do not blink; truth is, I cannot.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，比你的嘴诚实。
lines.en: Your footsteps are more honest than your mouth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，把你逼到墙边。
lines.en: I shuffle slowly, pressing you to the wall.

lines.zh: 你换武器了？我等你换完。
lines.en: Changed weapons? I will wait till you finish.

lines.zh: 我一低头，就看不见你了。
lines.en: When I lower my head, I lose sight of you.

lines.zh: 你越退，我越高兴。
lines.en: The more you retreat, the happier I get.

lines.zh: 这一拳，能把土墙砸穿。
lines.en: This punch can break through a dirt wall.

lines.zh: 我抡起手臂，横扫一片。
lines.en: I swing my arm and sweep a whole row.

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，会连盾一起飞。
lines.en: A shield will not help; it flies off with you.

lines.zh: 我砸地，石头都跳起来。
lines.en: I smash the ground, and stones jump.

lines.zh: 你被我抓住，就甩出去。
lines.en: Once I grab you, I throw you.

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，风都变了向。
lines.en: That missed, and even the wind changed direction.

lines.zh: 我的拳比你人还大。
lines.en: My fist is bigger than you are.

lines.zh: 你倒地了，我还在往下砸。
lines.en: You are down, and I keep pounding.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞，比拳头还狠。
lines.en: My shoulder charge hits harder than my fist.

lines.zh: 别站我正前方，那里最危险。
lines.en: Do not stand right in front of me; that is the worst spot.

lines.zh: 土被顶开，我先伸出一只手。
lines.en: The soil breaks; first comes one hand.

lines.zh: 我从坑里爬出来，身上全是泥。
lines.en: I climb out of the pit covered in mud.

lines.zh: 雷雨夜里，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: On a stormy night, I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的吼声先到，身体后到。
lines.en: My roar arrives before my body does.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比旁边的树还高。
lines.en: I stand up taller than the trees nearby.

lines.zh: 谁把我埋在这？土太浅了。
lines.en: Who buried me here? The soil was too shallow.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的石块。
lines.en: I shake the stones off my back.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找吃的。
lines.en: The first thing I do is look for food.

lines.zh: 我摸到自己的脸，少了一块。
lines.en: I touch my face and a piece is missing.

lines.zh: 村子里的灯，我一盏盏看过去。
lines.en: I look at the village lights one by one.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的皮，很响。
lines.en: Fire scorches my hide with a loud crackle.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from height and make a crater.

lines.zh: 水漫过头顶，我还在走。
lines.en: Water closes over my head, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推出去好几步。
lines.en: The explosion throws me several steps back.

lines.zh: 箭插在我胸口，像根针。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest like a needle.

lines.zh: 紫光缠住我，皮在发麻。
lines.en: Violet light wraps me and my hide goes numb.

lines.zh: 饿得我连石头都想咬。
lines.en: So hungry I would bite a stone.

lines.zh: 雷落在我肩上，我一动不动。
lines.en: Lightning lands on my shoulder, and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我往下沉。
lines.en: The ground vanishes, and I sink down.
